entities.summary: Ludwig Schnorr von Carolsfeld was a German heldentenor. The son of painter Julius Schnorr von Carolsfeld, he was trained as a vocalist at the Kreuzschule in Dresden and the Leipzig Conservatory. He was a resident artist at the Karlsruhe Hofoper from 1854–1860, and the Semperoper in Dresden from 1860–1865.
